title: Project record
description: data/project.json -- the project as its .woodcore file describes it, and what produced this export: Woodcore's version and git revision, Typst's version, and the SHA-256 of every workbook read (calc/project.py record, v0.82). The report's title page and the PDF's metadata print from it (lib/calc-engine.typ project-info, woodcore-document), and every archive of an export keeps it. It carries no date, so an export repeated on the same inputs writes the same bytes.

schema_version.description: -- pinned: a record written at another version is refused rather than read as this one.

revision.description: `git describe --always --dirty` of the program's checkout; empty for a frozen program.

typst.description: The version of the Typst found to compile the report, empty where none answered.

workbooks.description: {file name: SHA-256} of Positionen.xlsx and of every load workbook the export read.

revision.description: The report's latest revision, the newest entry of its journal (calc/journal.py, docs/domain/journal.md §3.3terdecies), which the PDF's keywords name -- «Rev. 3 (2026-09-27)». Optional and additive: absent where the journal is empty and from every record written before v0.99, so the schema version is deliberately NOT bumped for it and an older export still compiles (woodcore-document reads it with a default). Its date is the engineer's typed day, not a clock reading, so an unchanged journal writes the same bytes.
